items.headline: Hunter Biden Slams $LAPTOP Market Maker: 'Buy It All Back'
items.summary: Hunter Biden says the $LAPTOP memecoin's market maker should buy back and burn the supply, after a report detailed thin liquidity and MM-linked gains at launch.

items.headline: $JTO's JTX Plots Mobile App, Perps Next on Solana
items.summary: Jito's JTX is launching a mobile app this fall with equities and perps on the roadmap, expanding beyond spot trading on Solana.

items.headline: $LDO Unveils Morpho-Based Lending for Staking Loops
items.summary: Lido revealed Lido Lend, a Morpho-based lending protocol targeting Q4 launch, built for leveraged staking loops with collateral screening.

items.headline: $INJ Meridian Upgrade Goes Live With RWA Controls
items.summary: Injective's Meridian mainnet upgrade expands issuer controls for tokenized assets and begins private trading tests, with the CypherOS privacy layer coming later.

items.headline: $ADA Launches Programmable Tokens With Issuer Controls
items.summary: Cardano's new programmable token standard is live, letting issuers set rules like freezes and forced transfers. Wallets and DEXs must integrate to support the assets.
